generated_for: Adjutant PRD v1.0 / Technical Architecture v1.0

bus.serialization: JSON with a schema-registry-enforced contract; Avro migration path reserved for adj.metrics.v1 if volume demands it
bus.delivery: at-least-once; consumers are idempotent on envelope.event_id
bus.publish_mechanism: transactional outbox + relay. Services never publish directly from application code paths that also write Postgres.
bus.large_payload_policy: Anything over 256 KiB is written to S3 and referenced by key. Scene graphs and rationales are always referenced, never inlined.

envelope_schema.title: Adjutant Event Envelope v1
envelope_schema.description: Every event on every topic carries this envelope. Consumers MUST reject any message that fails envelope validation rather than attempting partial interpretation.

event_id.description: Consumer idempotency key. UUIDv7 so it sorts by time.

occurred_at.description: When the fact became true in the domain.

produced_at.description: When the outbox relay published it. Skew between the two is the observability signal for relay lag.

producer.description: Emitting service and version, e.g. approval-svc@1.4.2

brand_id.description: Tenant key and partition key. Never null; platform-level events use the reserved nil UUID.

trace_id.description: W3C trace-id, propagated from the originating request.

workflow_id.description: Temporal workflow id, when the producer runs inside a workflow.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that directly caused this one.

correlation_id.description: Stable across a whole business transaction (e.g. one plan's lifecycle).

schema_ref.description: URI of the payload schema this message was validated against at publish time.

redaction.description: Declares fields stripped before publish. Present only when stripping occurred.

events.purpose: Starts OnboardBrandWorkflow and provisions tenant storage prefixes and vector namespace.
Draft Brand Graph is ready for human confirmation. Carries the confidence surface the UI uses to order review.

low_confidence_paths.description: field_paths below the confirmation threshold; these are what the user is asked to review.

unresolved_claims.description: Claims found in source copy with no substantiating provenance. Non-zero here constrains generation.

events.purpose: Human confirmed the graph. Gate for any generation: no creative may be produced against an unconfirmed graph (BG-4).
Palette, typeface, logo or tone changed. Invalidates the render cache for affected scene graphs.
Highest-priority control event. Gateway must refuse all egress for this brand and fan out pause mutations.
events.ordering_guarantee: total order per brand_id; consumed with max priority and a 60s SLO
events.notes: Kill switch is ALSO a synchronous call. The event is the fan-out mechanism, never the authority. Gateway reads brand_kill_switch on every egress call regardless.

events.purpose: Strategist produced a plan. Triggers compliance pre-check before it can reach a human.

allocation.description: channel -> usd; must sum to monthly_budget_usd

rationale_ref.description: Pointer to the stored strategist rationale (ST-6). Not inlined; it can be long.

events.purpose: Plan-level verdict. A block verdict prevents the plan from entering the approval queue.
Notification only. The authoritative resume signal is the Temporal signal, not this event (see contract doc §3.2).
Rejection reasons are training signal for the Strategist; this is the feedback loop for approval-accept rate.
The plan mutated after approval. Every outstanding token for it is dead. Emitted by the same transaction that voids them.
One brief fanned out into a creative set. Carries the generation budget ceiling for cost control.
A distinct concept (angle + hook + visual direction), before any rendering.

claims_made.description: Each must resolve to a provenanced assertion or compliance blocks the set.

events.purpose: Immutable scene graph version pinned. Render fan-out keys off this.

text_layer_ids.description: Layers that must render typographically and must never be rasterized into a diffusion image.

events.purpose: One rendition produced. Content-addressed, so a repeat of the same (graph, spec) is a cache hit and emits with cache_hit=true.
Hard stop. A creative that fails spec validation cannot enter the approval queue (CR-2). Reviewers never see broken renditions.
Notification of creative-set approval. Token id included for audit correlation only.
Asset-level verdict with the full finding set and the disclosures actually applied.
An Owner overrode a block. Permanently retained, separately alertable, and surfaced in the audit export.
Policy corpus version bump, including rules promoted from the rejection-intelligence loop.

requires_recheck_of_pending.description: When true, everything sitting in the approval queue is re-checked before it can be consumed.

events.purpose: Something needs a human. Drives the queue UI, the notification fan-out, and the queue-latency SLO.

compliance_verdict.description: block can never appear here; blocked subjects cannot be queued.

events.purpose: Terminal human decision at one stage. pending_client transitions require a prior internal approval.

latency_seconds.description: Feeds the approval-queue-latency metric, the leading indicator for the top product risk.

events.purpose: A spend authority now exists. Payload carries token metadata only — never the signature or the serialized token.
events.notes: The signature and nonce are deliberately absent. Publishing a usable token on a topic with 90-day retention would make the bus a spend-authority store.

events.purpose: One (token, channel, operation) tuple burned, with the USD actually committed against the caps.
Token killed before use. Gateway drops it from its local validity cache immediately.
Nobody decided in time. Feeds the abandonment metric that tells us whether the queue is a bottleneck.
Deployment record opened. Channels proceed as independent units of success from here.
One channel is blocked before any spend. Other channels continue; this is not a deployment-wide failure.
Per-channel terminal outcome with verified native ids. Verification is a read-back, not an assumption from the write response.

reconciled.description: true when the create was found pre-existing and adopted rather than re-created.

events.purpose: Arms MonitorBrandWorkflow. Terminal for the deployment aggregate.
Credential or account health transition. A revoked connection voids outstanding tokens scoped to that channel.
Structure sync found drift between our intent and the platform's reality. Includes changes made outside Adjutant.

changed_externally.description: true when the change did not originate from an Adjutant action; surfaces as drift in the UI.

events.purpose: Platform disapproval captured verbatim. Input to the rejection-intelligence loop that grows the policy corpus.

raw_reason.description: Verbatim platform text. Never normalized on ingest; classification is a separate derived field.

events.purpose: Governor bucket empty. Surfaces real queue position to the user instead of a spinner.

observed_429.description: true only when the platform actually returned 429. We never probe limits.

events.purpose: Watermark event for a completed metric window. Downstream scans trigger off watermarks, never off wall-clock.

restated_rows.description: Platforms restate history; a non-zero value invalidates derived rollups for the window.

events.purpose: Statistically significant deviation, with the significance evidence attached so downstream can refuse weak signals.
Compound fatigue only. Consumers must reject any message with fewer than three signals fired.
events.notes: minItems: 3 on signals_fired is the schema-level mirror of the fatigue_requires_compound_signals database constraint. Enforced in two places on purpose.

events.purpose: The Optimizer proposes; it never writes. Its tool allowlist contains no write verbs.

evidence_refs.description: anomaly/fatigue event ids that justify it (OP-6)

events.purpose: Human or rule decision. auto_approved is recorded distinctly from human_approved for audit and for autonomy-graduation analysis.
Mutation applied and verified, with the guardrail re-check result recorded at execution time.
events.notes: rejected_by_guardrail is the expected outcome for a proposal approved Monday that violates a ceiling by Wednesday. It is not an error.

events.purpose: Rollback executed by walking action.revert_path in reverse.
Per-invocation cost meter. This topic is the sole input to margin-per-brand; nothing else may claim generation cost.
Generation budget guard. Crossing hard degrades the brand to a cheaper model tier rather than silently burning margin.
Outcome attached to creative attributes. Global-scope signals must be de-identified and past the k-anonymity threshold.
events.notes: Consumers must drop any scope=global message with deidentified=false. Mirrors the global_signals_deidentified constraint.

events.purpose: Report artifact ready. Cross-channel aggregates carry their methodology annotation as a first-class field.

methodology_annotations.description: Required whenever any caveated metric is aggregated across channels. Empty array is only valid when all metrics are comparability_class=direct.

events.purpose: Delivery receipt per recipient.
events.notes: recipient_email is redacted at publish time. The envelope's redaction block records that it happened.

recipient_ref.description: Opaque recipient id. Raw email addresses are stripped before publish; see envelope.redaction.

events.purpose: Mirror of an append-only audit-ledger row, for real-time security monitoring. The database remains the record of truth.
events.notes: Emitted from the transactional outbox in the same transaction as the ledger insert, so the bus cannot disagree with the ledger.
